value.body: A science degree on how the environment works and how people affect it: ecology, environmental chemistry, air and water pollution, waste management, natural resources, environmental law and impact assessment, with lab and field work. It is often studied with Chemistry, Botany or Zoology. It leads to compliance, consultancy, lab and NGO roles, or an M.Sc.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4 years for Honours / Honours with Research under the UGC four-year UG framework (NEP 2020)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in the science stream (Physics, Chemistry with Biology or Mathematics). Central universities admit through CUET-UG; many state universities and colleges admit on Class 12 merit or a state test.

value.title: At a glance
items: Environmental studies is a compulsory course for all undergraduates; this is a full major, which is different.
Many consultancy and EIA roles prefer an M.Sc.
For the Indian Forest Service, the degree must include one of UPSC's listed subjects, such as Botany, Chemistry or Zoology.
Industry EHS, pollution-monitoring labs and NGOs are common first employers.
